candidates.summary: img-src allows only the bare gateway origin, so a subdomain gateway's redirect (Kubo's default on localhost) is CSP-blocked and every IPFS image fails
candidates.failure_scenario: gnoweb (strict by default) with -ipfs-gateway http://localhost:8080, an origin normalizeIPFSGateway accepts and ipfs_test.go:26 lists as valid, against a stock Kubo node: the rewritten gets Kubo's implicit localhost subdomain-gateway redirect to http://.ipfs.localhost:8080/, which the CSP's 'http://localhost:8080' host-source does not match, so the browser blocks every rewritten image while gnoweb starts and logs nothing. The same holds for any self-hosted gateway run in subdomain mode (UseSubdomains: true), the origin-isolated setup the IPFS docs recommend; http://127.0.0.1:8080 works only because Kubo serves loopback IPs as a path gateway
candidates.verify_by: go test ./gno.land/cmd/gnoweb -run TestB2SubdomainGatewayRedirectCSP -v -count=1 with tests/b2-lines-subdomain-redirect-csp_test.go copied in (chromium on PATH): the no-strict control sees the <cid>.ipfs.localhost request, the strict case does not and chromium logs the img-src violation. Kubo premise: gh api repos/ipfs/kubo/contents/docs/config.md, 'Implicit defaults of Gateway.PublicGateways' (localhost UseSubdomains true) and UseSubdomains 'requests for content paths such as http://{hostname}/ipfs/{cid} produce redirect to http://{cid}.ipfs.{hostname}'
candidates.evidence: --- PASS: TestB2SubdomainGatewayRedirectCSP/no-strict_control (gateway saw: ["localhost:38323/ipfs/<cid>" "<cid>.ipfs.localhost:38323/"]); --- FAIL: TestB2SubdomainGatewayRedirectCSP/strict_(CSP) (gateway saw only "localhost:32931/ipfs/<cid>"); chromium: "Loading the image 'http://bafybei...fbzdi.ipfs.localhost:32931/' violates the following Content Security Policy directive: "img-src 'self' data: ... http://localhost:32931". The action has been blocked." Kubo docs/config.md: "localhost": {"Paths": ["/ipfs", "/ipns"], "UseSubdomains": true}; "requests for content paths such as `http://{hostname}/ipfs/{cid}` produce redirect to `http://{cid}.ipfs.{hostname}`"

dropped.settled_by: CSP3 port-part matching treats an explicit default port as matching a URL with a null port, and the browser normalizes https://gw:443/ipfs/x to a null port, so img-src and src still match; cosmetic only
